title: Matibag confirms NBI raids on houses allegedly owned by Velascos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) raided houses in August supposedly owned by former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and his wife, Rowena, NBI Director Melvin Matibag confirmed on Tuesday. In an interview, Matibag said the NBI conducted the raid on Aug. 24 after receiving intelligence information about supposed illegal firearms in houses in Valle Verde. “We applied for a search warrant. We searched for it, and it turned out that the houses named after other personalities were actually owned by the former speaker and Ms. Rowena, based on their admission when the search warrant was enforced,” he […]...
